items.title: Buy Southwest Rapid Rewards Points For 50% Off (1.5 Cents Each): Worth It?
items.why: Discounted points purchases show how airlines price loyalty currency, useful context when comparing earn value against buy-in costs.
items.summary_ai: Southwest is discounting purchased Rapid Rewards points by up to 50%, to 1.5 cents each, though buying still rarely pays off.
items.take: Discounted points purchases show how airlines price loyalty currency, useful context when comparing earn value against buy-in costs.
